name: pricing
description: Three-tier pricing slide. Three equal cards (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) with the middle one visually elevated via a darker border. Tier name, price (big bold), unit, feature bullets.
when_to_use: Pitch deck pricing slide. SaaS pricing comparison. When the brief says 'pricing', 'plans', 'tiers'.

slot_hints.label: Tier 1 unit + features (newline-separated)
slot_hints.example:
per user / month

· Up to 5 seats
· 10 GB storage

slot_hints.label: Tier 3 unit + features
slot_hints.example: tailored to your team\n\n· Everything in Pro
